transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I’m here because people keep saying I’m acting crazy. My husband, and some people at the warehouse… they’ve been watching what I do. Changing pallet counts and stuff so I don’t get that supervisor spot. I know how it sounds, but that’s what’s been going on.
Do you feel like people are specifically targeting you or trying to interfere with your work, or is it more that you're noticing changes and feel it's directed at you?

It’s not just me “noticing changes.” They’re doing it on purpose. My husband and people at the warehouse watch what I do, and the pallet counts get changed so I look bad… so I don’t get that supervisor spot.
Do you believe these people are acting against you without just cause, even though there may be no clear evidence?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t have papers or anything to prove it. But I know what’s happening. My husband and those people at the warehouse keep watching what I do, changing pallet counts, making me look crazy so I won’t get that supervisor spot.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed things that others around you don’t seem to notice?
Sometimes… yeah. Like if I’m in the aisle at work, or folding clothes at home, I’ll hear a man’s voice real clear saying, “Nicole, check it again.” And there’s nobody near me.
Do you ever feel like people are talking about you or plotting against you outside of work, or maybe even that someone is trying to harm you in other ways?

I mean… mostly it’s my husband and people at the warehouse. They act like I’m crazy, but I know they’re watching what I do and messing with the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. Outside of that… I don’t know. That’s the main thing.
Do you ever feel like people outside of work, like neighbors or friends, are watching you or trying to interfere with your life in some way?

Not really neighbors or friends… I don’t talk to people like that much. It’s more my husband and the warehouse people. They keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’re watching what I do and messing with the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot.
Do you ever feel like someone is putting thoughts into your mind or controlling your actions against your will?

Not like… thoughts put in my head, no. It’s more that my husband and the people at the warehouse are watching what I do and messing with the pallet counts, trying to keep me from getting that supervisor spot.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts are not your own, or that someone is placing thoughts in your mind that you didn’t think yourself?

No… not like somebody putting thoughts in my head. It’s more… like I said, my husband and people at the warehouse watching what I’m doing, changing the pallet counts so I don’t get moved up. That’s what’s been happening.
Do you ever feel that random events or things people say in general are specifically about you or meant to send you a message, even if they don’t seem related to others?

No… not random stuff like that. It’s more specific. My husband and the warehouse people… they watch what I’m doing, and the pallet counts get changed. That’s what’s keeping me from that supervisor spot.

Have you ever felt that events, objects, or actions in the world around you—like things on TV, songs playing, or things people say in public—were directed at you or had a special meaning for you specifically?

Not TV or songs or anything like that. It’s more… people around me. My husband and folks at the warehouse watching what I do, changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. They act like I’m making it up, but I know what’s going on.
Do you believe that people outside of the warehouse, like your neighbors or others in your daily life, are also involved in trying to keep you from getting ahead?

Not really neighbors, no. I haven’t… I haven’t seen that. It’s my husband and the people at the warehouse. They’re the ones watching what I do and messing with the pallet counts so I don’t get moved up.

Do you ever feel like your husband or the people at the warehouse are working together in a coordinated way to make sure you don’t get that supervisor position, like they’re part of a plan or agreement?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t know what they call it, but it feels coordinated. My husband and the warehouse people keep watching what I’m doing, and then the pallet counts get changed. They act like I’m crazy, but I know that’s why I’m not getting the supervisor spot.

Have you ever felt that your actions, thoughts, or behaviors are being controlled by an outside force or person, as if someone else is making you do things or think certain thoughts against your will?

No… not like someone’s making me do things or putting thoughts in my head. It’s more that they’re watching what I do and messing with the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. That’s what I came in about.
Outside of work and your husband, has anything ever happened in your life that made you feel like people were working against you or trying to send you a hidden message?

No… not really outside of that. It’s mostly what I said—my husband and the people at the warehouse. They keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’re watching me and changing those pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor job.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts are not your own or that someone is placing thoughts in your mind that you didn’t think yourself?
No… I don’t think so. My thoughts feel like mine. I haven’t noticed anything like somebody putting thoughts in my head.
Have you ever felt that things people say, or events happening around you, are directly related to you or meant for you, even if they don’t seem connected to others?

I mean… yeah, sort of. At work, it feels like what they’re doing is aimed at me. Like they’re watching how I move and then changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. And when my husband acts like I’m crazy about it… it feels connected.
Have you ever felt that your actions or what you do is being controlled by something or someone else, like an outside force or power, not just your husband or coworkers watching you?

Not like… something controlling my body, no. It’s more that they’re watching what I do at the warehouse and messing with the pallet counts to block me from that supervisor job. And then my husband acts like I’m making it up.
Have you ever felt that something beyond your husband and coworkers—like a force or power—is involved in watching you or interfering with your work?

I don’t know about, like, a force or power. I just know my husband and people at the warehouse keep acting like I’m crazy, but they’re watching what I do and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot.

opening_question.intent: Identify the patient's chief complaint or reason for seeking psychiatric evaluation
opening_question.question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with persistent, non-bizarre delusions centered around a specific theme (persecution at work and by her husband), without prominent hallucinations or other symptoms of schizophrenia. The delusional theme is consistent and fixed, and there is no evidence of a decline in functioning outside of the delusional context, which aligns with delusional disorder (F22.0). Schizophrenia (F20.0) was considered due to possible auditory hallucinations, but these were infrequent and not a primary feature of the clinical presentation.
